description: Artifact Librarian service for managing build artifacts and content items

metric_definitions.query_template: SELECT countIf(StatusCode = 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') / count() * 100 AS error_rate FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = '{service_name}' AND Timestamp >= '{time_start}' AND Timestamp <= '{time_end}'
metric_definitions.description: Percentage of artifact operations resulting in errors

metric_definitions.query_template: SELECT quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1000000 AS p95_ms FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = '{service_name}' AND Timestamp >= '{time_start}' AND Timestamp <= '{time_end}'

SELECT countIf(StatusCode = 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') / count() * 100 AS error_rate FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = '{service_name}' AND SpanName = 'put' AND Timestamp >= '{time_start}' AND Timestamp <= '{time_end}'
metric_definitions.description: Error rate for artifact upload (put) operations

metric_definitions.query_template: SELECT quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1000000 AS p95_ms FROM otel_traces WHERE ServiceName = '{service_name}' AND SpanName LIKE '%graph%' AND Timestamp >= '{time_start}' AND Timestamp <= '{time_end}'
metric_definitions.description: 95th percentile latency of graph query operations
